summary: This is a routine monthly return filed by WeRide Inc., a foreign private issuer, with the Hong Kong Stock Exchange regarding movements in authorized and issued share capital for June 2026. The filing details minimal changes—A shares decreased by 6,825,143 issued shares, compensated by an equal increase in treasury shares, while total issued shares remained flat at 972,508,041. No acquisition, divestiture, tender, or strategic event is present. It is purely a regulatory compliance submission under HKEX rules and does not constitute a special situation.
